_doc: Reviewed classifications for scripts/verify_i18n_completeness.py. Every entry: classification (one of the audit's ALLOWED_CLASSES) + reason. tokens: substrings ignored when judging a value. entries: {locale ('*' = every locale), key, classification, reason} for whole values that legitimately stay identical / bilingual. hardcodedFiles / hardcodedPatterns: classify hard-coded literals (reported metric on this branch).
